learning_outcomes.text: Explains the basic principles of material handling and conveying systems.
Compares the operating principles of different transport systems and selects the appropriate system.
Performs basic design and capacity calculations for conveyors, elevators, and lifting equipment.
Evaluates energy requirements, efficiency, and occupational safety criteria in transport systems.
Analyzes appropriate transport and storage systems for industrial applications using engineering approaches.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Transport Engineering, Importance of Material Handling and Basic Concepts
Classification of Material Handling Systems and System Selection Criteria
Transport System Selection Criteria and Economic Analysis
Belt Conveyors: Structure, Operating Principles and Design Fundamentals
Screw Conveyors and Transport Capacity Calculations
Power and Energy Calculations in Transport Systems
Automated Transport Systems, AGV and AS/RS Systems
Occupational Safety, Maintenance and Failure Analysis in Transport Systems
Modern Transport Technologies and Industrial Application Examples
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are determined by the University Senate and specified in the academic calendar.
